        (function () {

            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Minutes and Agendas</h1>
        
        
        <div>
<div>
<h3 style="text-align: left;"><script id="mcjs">!function(c,h,i,m,p){m=c.createElement(h),p=c.getElementsByTagName(h)[0],m.async=1,m.src=i,p.parentNode.insertBefore(m,p)}(document,"script","https://chimpstatic.com/mcjs-connected/js/users/0169540149a7fbdf4d8422b76/5e6a235991590340de3cf94ed.js");</script> Council Meetings</h3>
</div>
</div>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are held on the fourth Monday of the month (third Monday in December) at 5.30pm in the Council Chambers, Civic Centre, 18 Roberts Avenue, Horsham. The January Council meeting will be held on Tuesday 28th January due to the Australia Day public holiday falling on the fourth Monday of the month.</p>
<p><a title="2026-Council-Meeting-Dates.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/2026-council-meeting-dates.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 144KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are open to the public and community members are encouraged to attend. If you wish to raise a question during Public Question Time, please complete the <a href="https://au.openforms.com/Form/9bdc06e0-a830-4338-b8f1-95aa1882655a" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">Public Question Time form</a><span style="font-size: 1em;"> and lodge it with Council by 10am on the day of the Council meeting.</span> <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/forms/printable-version-public-question-time.pdf" target="_self" title="Printable-Version-Public-Question-Time.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Printable version of Public Question Time form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 54KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The Horsham Rural City Council <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a> and <a title="Local_Law_No_1_Governance_2016.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/services/local-lawscommunity-safety/local_law_no_1_governance_2016.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Local Law No.1 Governance (2016)<span class="file-info">(PDF, 402KB)</span></a>  provide a mechanism to facilitate the good government of Council with respect to the conduct of meetings, keeping of meeting records, election of the Mayor and Deputy Mayor and conflict of interest disclosure procedures.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 1em;">Council agendas are available on this page from 5pm on Thursdays prior to Council meetings.  Council agendas and minutes are provided below.  </span></p>
<p>To obtain a copy of Council Minutes previous to those listed on the website, or if you have any questions, please contact Council on 5382 9777 or email <a href="mailto:council@hrcc.vic.gov.au">council@hrcc.vic.gov.au</a></p>
<h3>Live streaming and video archives</h3>
<p>All Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are also available after each meeting.</p>
<p><a href="http://webcast.hrcc.vic.gov.au/" target="_blank" class="styled-button">Live streaming and meeting recordings  </a></p>
<p>For copyright information refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/policies-amp-procedures/live-streaming-recording-of-council-meetings-policy-feb2025.pdf" target="_blank" title="Live-Streaming-Recording-of-Council-Meetings-Policy-Feb2025.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 218KB)</span></a></p>
<h3>Petitions and joint letters</h3>
<p>Please refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a>, Division 9 for information relating to Petitions and joint letters.</p>
<p>If you wish to lodge a petition, please print the <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/governance/agenda-minutes-audio/petition-template-fillable_1.pdf" target="_blank" title="Petition-Template-fillable_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>petition and joint letter template<span class="file-info">(PDF, 226KB)</span></a> and lodge it with Council in sufficient time to be presented at the Council Meeting.</p>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

<div>
<h3 style="text-align: left;"><script id="mcjs">!function(c,h,i,m,p){m=c.createElement(h),p=c.getElementsByTagName(h)[0],m.async=1,m.src=i,p.parentNode.insertBefore(m,p)}(document,"script","https://chimpstatic.com/mcjs-connected/js/users/0169540149a7fbdf4d8422b76/5e6a235991590340de3cf94ed.js");</script> Council Meetings</h3>
</div>
</div>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are held on the fourth Monday of the month (third Monday in December) at 5.30pm in the Council Chambers, Civic Centre, 18 Roberts Avenue, Horsham. The January Council meeting will be held on Tuesday 28th January due to the Australia Day public holiday falling on the fourth Monday of the month.</p>
<p><a title="2026-Council-Meeting-Dates.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/2026-council-meeting-dates.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 144KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are open to the public and community members are encouraged to attend. If you wish to raise a question during Public Question Time, please complete the <a href="https://au.openforms.com/Form/9bdc06e0-a830-4338-b8f1-95aa1882655a" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">Public Question Time form</a><span style="font-size: 1em;"> and lodge it with Council by 10am on the day of the Council meeting.</span> <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/forms/printable-version-public-question-time.pdf" target="_self" title="Printable-Version-Public-Question-Time.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Printable version of Public Question Time form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 54KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The Horsham Rural City Council <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a> and <a title="Local_Law_No_1_Governance_2016.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/services/local-lawscommunity-safety/local_law_no_1_governance_2016.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Local Law No.1 Governance (2016)<span class="file-info">(PDF, 402KB)</span></a>  provide a mechanism to facilitate the good government of Council with respect to the conduct of meetings, keeping of meeting records, election of the Mayor and Deputy Mayor and conflict of interest disclosure procedures.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 1em;">Council agendas are available on this page from 5pm on Thursdays prior to Council meetings.  Council agendas and minutes are provided below.  </span></p>
<p>To obtain a copy of Council Minutes previous to those listed on the website, or if you have any questions, please contact Council on 5382 9777 or email <a href="mailto:council@hrcc.vic.gov.au">council@hrcc.vic.gov.au</a></p>
<h3>Live streaming and video archives</h3>
<p>All Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are also available after each meeting.</p>
<p><a href="http://webcast.hrcc.vic.gov.au/" target="_blank" class="styled-button">Live streaming and meeting recordings  </a></p>
<p>For copyright information refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/policies-amp-procedures/live-streaming-recording-of-council-meetings-policy-feb2025.pdf" target="_blank" title="Live-Streaming-Recording-of-Council-Meetings-Policy-Feb2025.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 218KB)</span></a></p>
<h3>Petitions and joint letters</h3>
<p>Please refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a>, Division 9 for information relating to Petitions and joint letters.</p>
<p>If you wish to lodge a petition, please print the <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/governance/agenda-minutes-audio/petition-template-fillable_1.pdf" target="_blank" title="Petition-Template-fillable_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>petition and joint letter template<span class="file-info">(PDF, 226KB)</span></a> and lodge it with Council in sufficient time to be presented at the Council Meeting.</p>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')

                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Minutes and Agendas</h1>
        
        
        <div>
<div>
<h3 style="text-align: left;"><script id="mcjs">!function(c,h,i,m,p){m=c.createElement(h),p=c.getElementsByTagName(h)[0],m.async=1,m.src=i,p.parentNode.insertBefore(m,p)}(document,"script","https://chimpstatic.com/mcjs-connected/js/users/0169540149a7fbdf4d8422b76/5e6a235991590340de3cf94ed.js");</script> Council Meetings</h3>
</div>
</div>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are held on the fourth Monday of the month (third Monday in December) at 5.30pm in the Council Chambers, Civic Centre, 18 Roberts Avenue, Horsham. The January Council meeting will be held on Tuesday 28th January due to the Australia Day public holiday falling on the fourth Monday of the month.</p>
<p><a title="2026-Council-Meeting-Dates.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/2026-council-meeting-dates.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 144KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are open to the public and community members are encouraged to attend. If you wish to raise a question during Public Question Time, please complete the <a href="https://au.openforms.com/Form/9bdc06e0-a830-4338-b8f1-95aa1882655a" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">Public Question Time form</a><span style="font-size: 1em;"> and lodge it with Council by 10am on the day of the Council meeting.</span> <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/forms/printable-version-public-question-time.pdf" target="_self" title="Printable-Version-Public-Question-Time.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Printable version of Public Question Time form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 54KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The Horsham Rural City Council <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a> and <a title="Local_Law_No_1_Governance_2016.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/services/local-lawscommunity-safety/local_law_no_1_governance_2016.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Local Law No.1 Governance (2016)<span class="file-info">(PDF, 402KB)</span></a>  provide a mechanism to facilitate the good government of Council with respect to the conduct of meetings, keeping of meeting records, election of the Mayor and Deputy Mayor and conflict of interest disclosure procedures.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 1em;">Council agendas are available on this page from 5pm on Thursdays prior to Council meetings.  Council agendas and minutes are provided below.  </span></p>
<p>To obtain a copy of Council Minutes previous to those listed on the website, or if you have any questions, please contact Council on 5382 9777 or email <a href="mailto:council@hrcc.vic.gov.au">council@hrcc.vic.gov.au</a></p>
<h3>Live streaming and video archives</h3>
<p>All Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are also available after each meeting.</p>
<p><a href="http://webcast.hrcc.vic.gov.au/" target="_blank" class="styled-button">Live streaming and meeting recordings  </a></p>
<p>For copyright information refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/policies-amp-procedures/live-streaming-recording-of-council-meetings-policy-feb2025.pdf" target="_blank" title="Live-Streaming-Recording-of-Council-Meetings-Policy-Feb2025.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 218KB)</span></a></p>
<h3>Petitions and joint letters</h3>
<p>Please refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a>, Division 9 for information relating to Petitions and joint letters.</p>
<p>If you wish to lodge a petition, please print the <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/governance/agenda-minutes-audio/petition-template-fillable_1.pdf" target="_blank" title="Petition-Template-fillable_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>petition and joint letter template<span class="file-info">(PDF, 226KB)</span></a> and lodge it with Council in sufficient time to be presented at the Council Meeting.</p>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Minutes and Agendas</h1>
        
        
        <div>
<div>
<h3 style="text-align: left;"><script id="mcjs">!function(c,h,i,m,p){m=c.createElement(h),p=c.getElementsByTagName(h)[0],m.async=1,m.src=i,p.parentNode.insertBefore(m,p)}(document,"script","https://chimpstatic.com/mcjs-connected/js/users/0169540149a7fbdf4d8422b76/5e6a235991590340de3cf94ed.js");</script> Council Meetings</h3>
</div>
</div>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are held on the fourth Monday of the month (third Monday in December) at 5.30pm in the Council Chambers, Civic Centre, 18 Roberts Avenue, Horsham. The January Council meeting will be held on Tuesday 28th January due to the Australia Day public holiday falling on the fourth Monday of the month.</p>
<p><a title="2026-Council-Meeting-Dates.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/2026-council-meeting-dates.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 144KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are open to the public and community members are encouraged to attend. If you wish to raise a question during Public Question Time, please complete the <a href="https://au.openforms.com/Form/9bdc06e0-a830-4338-b8f1-95aa1882655a" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">Public Question Time form</a><span style="font-size: 1em;"> and lodge it with Council by 10am on the day of the Council meeting.</span> <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/forms/printable-version-public-question-time.pdf" target="_self" title="Printable-Version-Public-Question-Time.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Printable version of Public Question Time form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 54KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The Horsham Rural City Council <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a> and <a title="Local_Law_No_1_Governance_2016.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/services/local-lawscommunity-safety/local_law_no_1_governance_2016.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Local Law No.1 Governance (2016)<span class="file-info">(PDF, 402KB)</span></a>  provide a mechanism to facilitate the good government of Council with respect to the conduct of meetings, keeping of meeting records, election of the Mayor and Deputy Mayor and conflict of interest disclosure procedures.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 1em;">Council agendas are available on this page from 5pm on Thursdays prior to Council meetings.  Council agendas and minutes are provided below.  </span></p>
<p>To obtain a copy of Council Minutes previous to those listed on the website, or if you have any questions, please contact Council on 5382 9777 or email <a href="mailto:council@hrcc.vic.gov.au">council@hrcc.vic.gov.au</a></p>
<h3>Live streaming and video archives</h3>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});

			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Minutes and Agendas</h1>
        
        
        <div>
<div>
<h3 style="text-align: left;"><script id="mcjs">!function(c,h,i,m,p){m=c.createElement(h),p=c.getElementsByTagName(h)[0],m.async=1,m.src=i,p.parentNode.insertBefore(m,p)}(document,"script","https://chimpstatic.com/mcjs-connected/js/users/0169540149a7fbdf4d8422b76/5e6a235991590340de3cf94ed.js");</script> Council Meetings</h3>
</div>
</div>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are held on the fourth Monday of the month (third Monday in December) at 5.30pm in the Council Chambers, Civic Centre, 18 Roberts Avenue, Horsham. The January Council meeting will be held on Tuesday 28th January due to the Australia Day public holiday falling on the fourth Monday of the month.</p>
<p><a title="2026-Council-Meeting-Dates.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/2026-council-meeting-dates.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 144KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are open to the public and community members are encouraged to attend. If you wish to raise a question during Public Question Time, please complete the <a href="https://au.openforms.com/Form/9bdc06e0-a830-4338-b8f1-95aa1882655a" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">Public Question Time form</a><span style="font-size: 1em;"> and lodge it with Council by 10am on the day of the Council meeting.</span> <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/forms/printable-version-public-question-time.pdf" target="_self" title="Printable-Version-Public-Question-Time.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Printable version of Public Question Time form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 54KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The Horsham Rural City Council <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a> and <a title="Local_Law_No_1_Governance_2016.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/services/local-lawscommunity-safety/local_law_no_1_governance_2016.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Local Law No.1 Governance (2016)<span class="file-info">(PDF, 402KB)</span></a>  provide a mechanism to facilitate the good government of Council with respect to the conduct of meetings, keeping of meeting records, election of the Mayor and Deputy Mayor and conflict of interest disclosure procedures.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 1em;">Council agendas are available on this page from 5pm on Thursdays prior to Council meetings.  Council agendas and minutes are provided below.  </span></p>
<p>To obtain a copy of Council Minutes previous to those listed on the website, or if you have any questions, please contact Council on 5382 9777 or email <a href="mailto:council@hrcc.vic.gov.au">council@hrcc.vic.gov.au</a></p>
<h3>Live streaming and video archives</h3>
<p>All Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are also available after each meeting.</p>
<p><a href="http://webcast.hrcc.vic.gov.au/" target="_blank" class="styled-button">Live streaming and meeting recordings  </a></p>
<p>For copyright information refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/policies-amp-procedures/live-streaming-recording-of-council-meetings-policy-feb2025.pdf" target="_blank" title="Live-Streaming-Recording-of-Council-Meetings-Policy-Feb2025.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 218KB)</span></a></p>
<h3>Petitions and joint letters</h3>
<p>Please refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a>, Division 9 for information relating to Petitions and joint letters.</p>
<p>If you wish to lodge a petition, please print the <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/governance/agenda-minutes-audio/petition-template-fillable_1.pdf" target="_blank" title="Petition-Template-fillable_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>petition and joint letter template<span class="file-info">(PDF, 226KB)</span></a> and lodge it with Council in sufficient time to be presented at the Council Meeting.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Minutes and Agendas</h1>
        
        
        <div>
<div>
<h3 style="text-align: left;"><script id="mcjs">!function(c,h,i,m,p){m=c.createElement(h),p=c.getElementsByTagName(h)[0],m.async=1,m.src=i,p.parentNode.insertBefore(m,p)}(document,"script","https://chimpstatic.com/mcjs-connected/js/users/0169540149a7fbdf4d8422b76/5e6a235991590340de3cf94ed.js");</script> Council Meetings</h3>
</div>
</div>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are held on the fourth Monday of the month (third Monday in December) at 5.30pm in the Council Chambers, Civic Centre, 18 Roberts Avenue, Horsham. The January Council meeting will be held on Tuesday 28th January due to the Australia Day public holiday falling on the fourth Monday of the month.</p>
<p><a title="2026-Council-Meeting-Dates.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/2026-council-meeting-dates.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 144KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are open to the public and community members are encouraged to attend. If you wish to raise a question during Public Question Time, please complete the <a href="https://au.openforms.com/Form/9bdc06e0-a830-4338-b8f1-95aa1882655a" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">Public Question Time form</a><span style="font-size: 1em;"> and lodge it with Council by 10am on the day of the Council meeting.</span> <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/forms/printable-version-public-question-time.pdf" target="_self" title="Printable-Version-Public-Question-Time.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Printable version of Public Question Time form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 54KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The Horsham Rural City Council <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a> and <a title="Local_Law_No_1_Governance_2016.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/services/local-lawscommunity-safety/local_law_no_1_governance_2016.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Local Law No.1 Governance (2016)<span class="file-info">(PDF, 402KB)</span></a>  provide a mechanism to facilitate the good government of Council with respect to the conduct of meetings, keeping of meeting records, election of the Mayor and Deputy Mayor and conflict of interest disclosure procedures.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 1em;">Council agendas are available on this page from 5pm on Thursdays prior to Council meetings.  Council agendas and minutes are provided below.  </span></p>
<p>To obtain a copy of Council Minutes previous to those listed on the website, or if you have any questions, please contact Council on 5382 9777 or email <a href="mailto:council@hrcc.vic.gov.au">council@hrcc.vic.gov.au</a></p>
<h3>Live streaming and video archives</h3>
<p>All Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are also available after each meeting.</p>
<p><a href="http://webcast.hrcc.vic.gov.au/" target="_blank" class="styled-button">Live streaming and meeting recordings  </a></p>
<p>For copyright information refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/policies-amp-procedures/live-streaming-recording-of-council-meetings-policy-feb2025.pdf" target="_blank" title="Live-Streaming-Recording-of-Council-Meetings-Policy-Feb2025.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 218KB)</span></a></p>
<h3>Petitions and joint letters</h3>
<p>Please refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a>, Division 9 for information relating to Petitions and joint letters.</p>
<p>If you wish to lodge a petition, please print the <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/governance/agenda-minutes-audio/petition-template-fillable_1.pdf" target="_blank" title="Petition-Template-fillable_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>petition and joint letter template<span class="file-info">(PDF, 226KB)</span></a> and lodge it with Council in sufficient time to be presented at the Council Meeting.</p>

    <div data-nosnippet>

<div class="item">

	<div class="title">Advisory</div>
	<div class="description">Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders are advised that this website contains the names and images of deceased persons.</div>
	<div class="link"></div>
	<div class="type">Announcement</div>

</div>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');

        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Minutes and Agendas</h1>
        
        
        <div>
<div>
<h3 style="text-align: left;"><script id="mcjs">!function(c,h,i,m,p){m=c.createElement(h),p=c.getElementsByTagName(h)[0],m.async=1,m.src=i,p.parentNode.insertBefore(m,p)}(document,"script","https://chimpstatic.com/mcjs-connected/js/users/0169540149a7fbdf4d8422b76/5e6a235991590340de3cf94ed.js");</script> Council Meetings</h3>
</div>
</div>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are held on the fourth Monday of the month (third Monday in December) at 5.30pm in the Council Chambers, Civic Centre, 18 Roberts Avenue, Horsham. The January Council meeting will be held on Tuesday 28th January due to the Australia Day public holiday falling on the fourth Monday of the month.</p>
<p><a title="2026-Council-Meeting-Dates.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/2026-council-meeting-dates.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 144KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are open to the public and community members are encouraged to attend. If you wish to raise a question during Public Question Time, please complete the <a href="https://au.openforms.com/Form/9bdc06e0-a830-4338-b8f1-95aa1882655a" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">Public Question Time form</a><span style="font-size: 1em;"> and lodge it with Council by 10am on the day of the Council meeting.</span> <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/forms/printable-version-public-question-time.pdf" target="_self" title="Printable-Version-Public-Question-Time.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Printable version of Public Question Time form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 54KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The Horsham Rural City Council <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a> and <a title="Local_Law_No_1_Governance_2016.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/services/local-lawscommunity-safety/local_law_no_1_governance_2016.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Local Law No.1 Governance (2016)<span class="file-info">(PDF, 402KB)</span></a>  provide a mechanism to facilitate the good government of Council with respect to the conduct of meetings, keeping of meeting records, election of the Mayor and Deputy Mayor and conflict of interest disclosure procedures.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 1em;">Council agendas are available on this page from 5pm on Thursdays prior to Council meetings.  Council agendas and minutes are provided below.  </span></p>
<p>To obtain a copy of Council Minutes previous to those listed on the website, or if you have any questions, please contact Council on 5382 9777 or email <a href="mailto:council@hrcc.vic.gov.au">council@hrcc.vic.gov.au</a></p>
<h3>Live streaming and video archives</h3>
<p>All Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are also available after each meeting.</p>
<p><a href="http://webcast.hrcc.vic.gov.au/" target="_blank" class="styled-button">Live streaming and meeting recordings  </a></p>
<p>For copyright information refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/policies-amp-procedures/live-streaming-recording-of-council-meetings-policy-feb2025.pdf" target="_blank" title="Live-Streaming-Recording-of-Council-Meetings-Policy-Feb2025.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 218KB)</span></a></p>
<h3>Petitions and joint letters</h3>
<p>Please refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a>, Division 9 for information relating to Petitions and joint letters.</p>
<p>If you wish to lodge a petition, please print the <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/governance/agenda-minutes-audio/petition-template-fillable_1.pdf" target="_blank" title="Petition-Template-fillable_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>petition and joint letter template<span class="file-info">(PDF, 226KB)</span></a> and lodge it with Council in sufficient time to be presented at the Council Meeting.</p>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();

                clearGuard();

        <div>
<div>
<h3 style="text-align: left;"><script id="mcjs">!function(c,h,i,m,p){m=c.createElement(h),p=c.getElementsByTagName(h)[0],m.async=1,m.src=i,p.parentNode.insertBefore(m,p)}(document,"script","https://chimpstatic.com/mcjs-connected/js/users/0169540149a7fbdf4d8422b76/5e6a235991590340de3cf94ed.js");</script> Council Meetings</h3>
</div>
</div>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are held on the fourth Monday of the month (third Monday in December) at 5.30pm in the Council Chambers, Civic Centre, 18 Roberts Avenue, Horsham. The January Council meeting will be held on Tuesday 28th January due to the Australia Day public holiday falling on the fourth Monday of the month.</p>
<p><a title="2026-Council-Meeting-Dates.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/2026-council-meeting-dates.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>2026 Council Meeting Dates<span class="file-info">(PDF, 144KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Council meetings are open to the public and community members are encouraged to attend. If you wish to raise a question during Public Question Time, please complete the <a href="https://au.openforms.com/Form/9bdc06e0-a830-4338-b8f1-95aa1882655a" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1em;">Public Question Time form</a><span style="font-size: 1em;"> and lodge it with Council by 10am on the day of the Council meeting.</span> <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/forms/printable-version-public-question-time.pdf" target="_self" title="Printable-Version-Public-Question-Time.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Printable version of Public Question Time form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 54KB)</span></a></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The Horsham Rural City Council <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a> and <a title="Local_Law_No_1_Governance_2016.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/services/local-lawscommunity-safety/local_law_no_1_governance_2016.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Local Law No.1 Governance (2016)<span class="file-info">(PDF, 402KB)</span></a>  provide a mechanism to facilitate the good government of Council with respect to the conduct of meetings, keeping of meeting records, election of the Mayor and Deputy Mayor and conflict of interest disclosure procedures.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 1em;">Council agendas are available on this page from 5pm on Thursdays prior to Council meetings.  Council agendas and minutes are provided below.  </span></p>
<p>To obtain a copy of Council Minutes previous to those listed on the website, or if you have any questions, please contact Council on 5382 9777 or email <a href="mailto:council@hrcc.vic.gov.au">council@hrcc.vic.gov.au</a></p>
<h3>Live streaming and video archives</h3>
<p>All Council meetings are live streamed and recordings are also available after each meeting.</p>
<p><a href="http://webcast.hrcc.vic.gov.au/" target="_blank" class="styled-button">Live streaming and meeting recordings  </a></p>
<p>For copyright information refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/policies-amp-procedures/live-streaming-recording-of-council-meetings-policy-feb2025.pdf" target="_blank" title="Live-Streaming-Recording-of-Council-Meetings-Policy-Feb2025.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 218KB)</span></a></p>
<h3>Petitions and joint letters</h3>
<p>Please refer to Council's <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/publications/governance-rules-june-2023.pdf" target="_blank" title="Governance-Rules-June-2023.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Governance Rules 2023<span class="file-info">(PDF, 818KB)</span></a>, Division 9 for information relating to Petitions and joint letters.</p>
<p>If you wish to lodge a petition, please print the <a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/document-resources/our-council/governance/agenda-minutes-audio/petition-template-fillable_1.pdf" target="_blank" title="Petition-Template-fillable_1.pdf" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>petition and joint letter template<span class="file-info">(PDF, 226KB)</span></a> and lodge it with Council in sufficient time to be presented at the Council Meeting.</p>
